disk-kind.url.note: What a disk is, in the tooltip of its icon and before its size in the line under its name (the Machines page's Disks tab and Disks pane) ("from a URL, 2.0 GiB"), and in Add a disk… › A disk already in this browser. A disk read from a web server.

disk-kind.file.note: What a disk is, in the tooltip of its icon and before its size in the line under its name (the Machines page's Disks tab and Disks pane), and in Add a disk… › A disk already in this browser. A disk whose base image is read where it is, a file on the user's computer.

disk-kind.stored.note: What a disk is, in the tooltip of its icon and before its size in the line under its name (the Machines page's Disks tab and Disks pane), and in Add a disk… › A disk already in this browser. A disk whose base image is copied into this browser's storage.

disk-kind.blank.note: What a disk is, in the tooltip of its icon and before its size in the line under its name (the Machines page's Disks tab and Disks pane), and in Add a disk… › A disk already in this browser. An empty disk (its base image all zeros) whose overlay is kept in this browser as the guest writes it.

disk-kind.ramdisk.note: What a disk is, in the tooltip of its icon and before its size in the line under its name (the Machines page's Disks tab and Disks pane), and in Add a disk… › A disk already in this browser. A disk held in memory, empty at every boot.

DiskInfo.meta.note: A disk in a list of disks (DiskInfo: the Machines page's Disks pane, Add a disk… › A disk already in this browser): the start of the small line under its name, before its overlays and its machines. {{kind}} is what it is (disk-kind.*), {{size}} its size.

DiskInfo.overlays_one.note: A disk in a list of disks (DiskInfo: the Machines page's Disks pane, Add a disk… › A disk already in this browser): how many overlays the disk has, its overlay empty, in its small line. {{count}} is 1.

DiskInfo.overlays_other.note: A disk in a list of disks (DiskInfo: the Machines page's Disks pane, Add a disk… › A disk already in this browser): how many overlays the disk has, they empty (or none), in its small line. {{count}} is how many.

DiskInfo.overlaysSized_one.note: A disk in a list of disks (DiskInfo: the Machines page's Disks pane, Add a disk… › A disk already in this browser): the disk's overlay, holding something, in its small line. {{count}} is 1, {{size}} what it holds.

DiskInfo.overlaysSized_other.note: A disk in a list of disks (DiskInfo: the Machines page's Disks pane, Add a disk… › A disk already in this browser): the disk's overlays, holding something, in its small line. {{count}} is how many, {{size}} what they hold together.

DiskInfo.on.note: A disk in a list of disks (DiskInfo: the Machines page's Disks pane, Add a disk… › A disk already in this browser): the end of the disk's small line: the machines that have it. {{machines}} is their names, joined with commas.

DiskInfo.onNone.note: A disk in a list of disks (DiskInfo: the Machines page's Disks pane, Add a disk… › A disk already in this browser): the end of the disk's small line when no machine has it.

Disks.newOverlay.text.message: With an empty overlay, the disk's contents will reflect its image. Enter a name for the new overlay:
Disks.newOverlay.text.note: Machines page, Disks: the question of the text prompt that New empty opens, above the field for the new overlay's name.

Disks.newOverlay.name.note: Machines page, Disks: the name the New empty prompt suggests for the new, empty overlay (the user can change it before Create).

Disks.newOverlay.title.note: Machines page, Disks: the title of the text prompt that New empty opens (naming a new, empty overlay of the disk).

Disks.newOverlay.ok.note: Machines page, Disks: the confirm button of the New empty prompt: makes the overlay and switches the disk to it.

Disks.busy.newOverlay.note: Machines page: the busy line (shown with a trailing …) while a new, empty overlay is made and the disk switched to it.

Disks.failed.newOverlay.note: Machines page: the error headline when New empty fails to make the overlay or switch the disk to it; why is the detail under it.

Disks.busy.switch.note: Machines page: the busy line (shown with a trailing …) while the disk switches to the overlay chosen in its Changes in list.

Disks.failed.switch.note: Machines page: the error headline when the disk can't switch to the overlay chosen in its Changes in list; why is the detail under it.

Disks.busy.change.note: Machines page: the busy line (shown with a trailing …) while a disk's read-only, swap or write in place box is saved.

Disks.detach.keptRamdisk.message: The empty ramdisk continues to exist, taking no space.
Disks.detach.keptRamdisk.note: Machines page, Disks: the middle sentence of the detach confirmation (Disks.detach.confirm) for a ramdisk.

Disks.detach.kept.message: The disk remains stored in this browser, taking space.
Disks.detach.kept.note: Machines page, Disks: the middle sentence of the detach confirmation (Disks.detach.confirm) for a disk without overlays.

Disks.detach.keptOverlays_one.message: The disk and its {{count}} overlay ({{size}}) remain stored in this browser, taking space.
Disks.detach.keptOverlays_one.note: Machines page, Disks: the middle sentence of the detach confirmation (Disks.detach.confirm) for a disk with one overlay. {{count}} is 1, {{size}} what the overlay holds.

Disks.detach.keptOverlays_other.message: The disk and its {{count}} overlays ({{size}}) remain stored in this browser, taking space.
Disks.detach.keptOverlays_other.note: Machines page, Disks: the middle sentence of the detach confirmation (Disks.detach.confirm) for a disk with several overlays. {{count}} is how many, {{size}} what they hold together.

Disks.detach.theDisk.note: Machines page, Disks: names the disk in the detach confirmation (Disks.detach.confirm) when its record is missing.

Disks.detach.confirm.message: Detach {{disk}} from {{machine}}? {{kept}} To delete it or to attach it again, to this or another machine, use Add a disk… › A disk already in this browser.
Disks.detach.confirm.note: Machines page, Disks: the confirmation that a disk's Detach asks. {{disk}} is the disk's name (or Disks.detach.theDisk), {{machine}} the machine's, {{kept}} one of Disks.detach.kept, Disks.detach.keptOverlays, Disks.detach.keptRamdisk.

Disks.detach.title.note: Machines page, Disks: the title of the confirmation that a disk's Detach asks.

Disks.detach.ok.note: Machines page, Disks: the confirm button of the question before a disk is taken off the machine.

Disks.busy.detach.note: Machines page: the busy line (shown with a trailing …) while a disk is taken off the machine.

Disks.missing.note: Machines page, Disks: shown in place of a disk's name when the machine attaches a disk whose record is gone.

Disks.meta.note: Machines page, Disks: the small line beside a disk's name. {{kind}} is what it is (Disks.kind.*), {{size}} its size, {{letter}} its device's letter in the guest (vda, vdb…).

Disks.meta.missing.note: Machines page, Disks: the small line beside a missing disk (Disks.missing). {{letter}} is its device's letter in the guest (vda, vdb…).

Disks.readOnly.note: Machines page, Disks: the checkbox on a disk's line: the guest can read it but not write it (off and disabled for a blank disk or a ramdisk).

Disks.swap.title.message: Automatically configure the guest to use this ramdisk as swap. The guest must be running systemd version 254 or above. The memory usage of this ramdisk on your computer will fluctuate as the guest uses the swap space.
Disks.swap.title.note: Machines page, Disks: the tooltip of a ramdisk's swap checkbox.

Disks.swap.note: Machines page, Disks: the checkbox on a ramdisk's line that makes it the guest's swap.

Disks.inPlace.title.message: The guest's writes go into the stored disk itself. Overlays are not used and snapshots can't fork it.
Disks.inPlace.title.note: Machines page, Disks: the tooltip of a stored disk's write in place checkbox.

Disks.inPlace.note: Machines page, Disks: the checkbox on a writable stored disk's line: the guest writes the disk itself, with no overlay.

Disks.busy.move.note: Machines page: the busy line (shown with a trailing …) while a disk moves to an earlier or later slot.

Disks.moveUp.title.message: Move the disk up one place. The guest sees the disks in this order (vda, vdb, …).
Disks.moveUp.title.note: Machines page, Disks: the tooltip of the up arrow on a disk's line (the disk takes an earlier slot: vda before vdb).

Disks.moveDown.title.message: Move the disk down one place. The guest sees the disks in this order (vda, vdb, …).
Disks.moveDown.title.note: Machines page, Disks: the tooltip of the down arrow on a disk's line (the disk takes a later slot).

Disks.detach.button.title.message: Take the disk off this machine. It remains stored in this browser.
Disks.detach.button.title.note: Machines page, Disks: the tooltip of the Detach button on a disk's line.

Disks.detach.button.note: Machines page, Disks: the button on a disk's line that takes it off the machine (after a confirmation).

Disks.overlays.label.note: Machines page, Disks: the label before the list of a writable disk's overlays (the variants of its changes), where the user picks the one the machine uses.

Disks.overlays.none.message: (a new overlay, at the next boot)
Disks.overlays.none.note: Machines page, Disks: the item of a disk's Changes in list when the machine has no overlay chosen yet: its next start makes one.

Disks.overlays.option.note: Machines page, Disks: an overlay in a disk's Changes in list. {{name}} is its name, {{size}} what it holds.

Disks.overlays.forked.note: Machines page, Disks: an overlay in a disk's Changes in list that a snapshot's restore forked off another. {{name}} is its name, {{size}} what it holds.

Disks.newEmpty.title.message: A new, empty overlay: the disk contents will be reset to those of the disk image. The current overlay is kept.
Disks.newEmpty.title.note: Machines page, Disks: the tooltip of New empty.

Disks.newEmpty.note: Machines page, Disks: the button under a writable disk that makes a new, empty overlay (asking its name) and switches the disk to it.

Disks.overlaysButton.title.message: Show all of this disk's overlays, to rename, delete or export them.
Disks.overlaysButton.title.note: Machines page, Disks: the tooltip of Overlays… on a disk.

Disks.overlaysButton.note: Machines page, Disks: the button on a disk with overlays that opens its Overlays dialog (every overlay of the disk, with Rename, Delete, Merge into the disk and Export).

Disks.importChanges.title.message: A changes file of this disk (created via Export › Changes only (qcow2)) becomes a new overlay, and the disk switches to it.
Disks.importChanges.title.note: Machines page, Disks: the tooltip of Import changes….

Disks.importChanges.note: Machines page, Disks: the button under a writable disk (not a blank one) that picks a changes file and loads it into a new overlay.

Disks.none.note: Machines page, Disks: the list's only line when the machine has no disk.

Disks.add.note: Machines page, Disks: the button under the list that opens the Add a disk wizard.

Disks.full.message: A machine can't have more than {{max}} disks.
Disks.full.note: Machines page, Disks: the note in place of Add a disk… when the machine has as many disks as it can. {{max}} is that number.

AddDisk.source.known.message: A disk already in this browser
AddDisk.source.known.note: Add a disk wizard (Machines page): the name of the choice of a disk the browser keeps already (shown only when there is one), on the first step's button.

AddDisk.source.known.text.message: A detached disk or one already associated with another machine. To delete a disk and free the space it takes, use Disks under the list of machines.
AddDisk.source.known.text.note: Add a disk wizard: what A disk already in this browser means, under its name on the first step, and the note at the top of its step.

AddDisk.title.known.message: Add a disk already in this browser
AddDisk.title.known.note: Add a disk wizard: the dialog's title once A disk already in this browser is chosen.

AddDisk.source.file.note: Add a disk wizard: the name of the choice of a disk image the page reads where it is, on the first step's button.

AddDisk.source.file.text.message: A disk image (qcow2, raw, or an installer or live ISO) read directly from outside the browser, without copying. The machine's writes go into an overlay in this browser. In later sessions, the browser will ask again for access to this file.
AddDisk.source.file.text.note: Add a disk wizard: what A file on your computer means, under its name on the first step, and the note at the top of its step.

AddDisk.title.file.message: Add a file on your computer
AddDisk.title.file.note: Add a disk wizard: the dialog's title once A file on your computer is chosen.

AddDisk.source.stored.message: A file, copied into this browser
AddDisk.source.stored.note: Add a disk wizard: the name of the choice of a disk image copied into this browser's storage, on the first step's button.

AddDisk.source.stored.text.message: The image is copied into this browser's storage. You will not be asked to select a file or authorize access to it again. You will be able to merge overlays into the image, and optionally enable writing in place instead of using overlays. It duplicates the file, in storage you can't easily manage except from this web app.
AddDisk.source.stored.text.note: Add a disk wizard: what A file, copied into this browser means, under its name on the first step, and the note at the top of its step.

AddDisk.title.stored.message: Copy a file into this browser
AddDisk.title.stored.note: Add a disk wizard: the dialog's title once A file, copied into this browser is chosen.

AddDisk.source.url.note: Add a disk wizard: the name of the choice of a disk image on a web server, on the first step's button.

AddDisk.source.url.text.message: An image on a web server, downloaded in segments as requested by the guest. The segments are cached in this browser. The server must allow this web app's origin, and it must support range requests when not specifying a chunked image's manifest.
AddDisk.source.url.text.note: Add a disk wizard: what From a URL means, under its name on the first step, and the note at the top of its step.

AddDisk.title.url.message: Add a disk from a URL
AddDisk.title.url.note: Add a disk wizard: the dialog's title once From a URL is chosen.

AddDisk.source.blank.note: Add a disk wizard: the name of the choice of an empty disk of a chosen size, on the first step's button.

AddDisk.source.blank.text.message: An empty disk of the size you choose, for the guest to partition and format. The space it takes in this browser will increase as the guest writes.
AddDisk.source.blank.text.note: Add a disk wizard: what Blank means, under its name on the first step, and the note at the top of its step.

AddDisk.title.blank.note: Add a disk wizard: the dialog's title once Blank is chosen.

AddDisk.source.ramdisk.note: Add a disk wizard: the name of the choice of a disk in memory, on the first step's button.

AddDisk.source.ramdisk.text.message: An empty disk held in your computer's memory, emptied at every boot of the guest. Useful as fast scratch space. It takes memory as the guest fills it. When the guest trims it (fstrim), the memory goes back to your computer for the first 4 GiB of the disk; beyond that, the ramdisk keeps it for reuse until the guest reboots or the machine is powered off.
AddDisk.source.ramdisk.text.note: Add a disk wizard: what Ramdisk means, under its name on the first step, and the note at the top of its step.

AddDisk.title.ramdisk.note: Add a disk wizard: the dialog's title once Ramdisk is chosen.

AddDisk.busy.note: Machines page: the busy line (shown with a trailing …) while the Add a disk wizard attaches or makes the disk.

add-disk.attachedAlready.message: {{name}} is already attached to this machine.
add-disk.attachedAlready.note: Add a disk wizard: the error under the fields when the file or URL chosen is a disk the browser knows that the machine has already. {{name}} is that disk's name.

add-disk.urlProblems.message: Couldn't add the disk from this URL
add-disk.urlProblems.note: Add a disk wizard › From a URL: the headline of the error under the fields when Add finds the server can't serve the URL as a disk; the URL check's problems (machines:urlcheck.*), what fails, are the causes under it, one per line.

add-disk.pickFirst.note: Add a disk wizard › A file on your computer or A file, copied into this browser: the error under the fields when Add is pressed before a file is picked.

add-disk.store.confirm.message: Copy {{name}} into this browser? The copy will take about {{size}} of this browser's storage ({{free}} free), and you can't easily manage it except from this web app.
add-disk.store.confirm.note: Add a disk wizard › A file, copied into this browser: the confirmation Add asks before copying. {{name}} is the file's name, {{size}} what the copy takes (estimated), {{free}} the browser's storage left.

add-disk.store.title.note: Add a disk wizard › A file, copied into this browser: the title of the confirmation before the file is copied.

add-disk.store.ok.note: Add a disk wizard › A file, copied into this browser: the confirm button that starts the copy.

add-disk.storing.note: Add a disk wizard › A file, copied into this browser: the progress line under the fields while the file is copied. {{name}} is the file's name, {{percent}} how much is done (0–100).

AddDisk.title.note: Add a disk wizard: the dialog's title on its first step (the source not chosen yet). {{machine}} is the machine's name.

AddDisk.where.message: Where does the disk come from?
AddDisk.where.note: Add a disk wizard: the note above the choices of the first step.

AddDisk.known.attach.note: Add a disk wizard › A disk already in this browser: the button on a listed disk that attaches it to the machine (with its overlays).

AddDiskUrl.url.note: Add a disk wizard › From a URL: the label of the field for the disk image's URL.

AddDiskUrl.url.checking.note: Add a disk wizard › From a URL: the Check button's words while the page asks the server about the URL.

AddDiskUrl.url.check.note: Add a disk wizard › From a URL: the button beside the URL field that asks the server whether it can serve the URL as a disk.

AddDiskUrl.url.ok.note: Add a disk wizard › From a URL: the line under the field when the check passes and the server said the size; a note on remote disks' first boot follows. {{size}} is the image's size.

AddDiskUrl.url.okUnknown.message: The server can serve it (size unknown).
AddDiskUrl.url.okUnknown.note: Add a disk wizard › From a URL: the line under the field when the check passes but the server didn't say the size; a note on remote disks' first boot follows.

AddDiskFile.pick.note: Add a disk wizard › A file on your computer or A file, copied into this browser: the button that opens the browser's file picker.

AddDiskFile.picked.note: Add a disk wizard › A file on your computer or A file, copied into this browser: beside Select a file…, the file selected. {{name}} is its name, {{size}} its size.

AddDiskFile.picked.none.note: Add a disk wizard › A file on your computer or A file, copied into this browser: beside Select a file… before a file is selected.

AddDisk.size.note: Add a disk wizard › Blank or Ramdisk: the label of the disk's size field.

AddDisk.size.unit.note: Add a disk wizard › Blank or Ramdisk: the unit after the size field (mebibytes).

AddDisk.readOnly.title.message: The guest can read the disk but can't write to it, so it has no overlay. This is checked automatically when you select an .iso file.
AddDisk.readOnly.title.note: Add a disk wizard › a file or a URL: the tooltip of the Read-only checkbox (checked by itself for a .iso file).

AddDisk.readOnly.note: Add a disk wizard › a file or a URL: the checkbox that attaches the disk read-only.

AddDisk.back.note: Add a disk wizard: the button that goes back to the first step (the choice of source).

AddDisk.cancel.note: Add a disk wizard: the button that closes the dialog without adding a disk.

AddDisk.add.note: Add a disk wizard: the primary button that adds the disk (not on A disk already in this browser, whose disks have Attach).

disks.pickAgain.message: This web app can't read {{name}} until you select the file again.
disks.pickAgain.note: Detail of an error (message bar or Machines page) when a disk that is a file on the user's computer has no handle kept: it can't be read until the user selects it again. {{name}} is the disk's name.

disks.overlayGone.message: The overlay no longer exists. It may have been deleted in another tab.
disks.overlayGone.note: Detail of an error on the Machines page (Disks), under Disks.failed.rename or .merge, when the overlay was deleted meanwhile (another tab).

disks.notThisDisk.message: The overlay no longer exists or belongs to another disk.
disks.notThisDisk.note: Detail of an error on the Machines page (Disks), under Disks.failed.switch or .newOverlay, when the overlay chosen in a disk's Changes in list is gone or belongs to another disk.

disks.overlayRunning.message: A machine using this overlay is running, in this tab or another. Power it off first.
disks.overlayRunning.note: Detail of an error on the Machines page (Disks), under Disks.failed.delete, when an overlay can't be deleted: a machine (in this tab or another) has it open.

disks.onlyStored.message: Only an overlay of a disk stored in this browser can be merged into it.
disks.onlyStored.note: Detail of an error on the Machines page (Disks), under Disks.failed.merge, when Merge into the disk is asked of a disk that isn't stored in this browser.

disks.overlayNamedRunning.message: A machine using the overlay {{name}} is running. Power it off first.
disks.overlayNamedRunning.note: Detail of an error on the Machines page (Disks), under Disks.failed.merge, when a merge is refused: a machine has the overlay, or another overlay of the disk the merge deletes, open. {{name}} is that overlay's name.

disks.diskRunning.message: A machine using this disk is running. Power it off first.
disks.diskRunning.note: Detail of an error on the Machines page (Disks), under Disks.failed.merge, when a merge is refused: a machine has the stored disk itself open.

export-worker.noChanges.message: This disk has no overlay, so it has no changes to save.
export-worker.noChanges.note: Detail under Couldn't save the disk (message bar) of a disk's Export › Changes only when the disk has no overlay: there are no changes to save.

export-worker.writingDisk.note: The page's state line while a disk is exported whole (raw or qcow2), followed by the percentage done.

export-worker.readingBase.note: The page's state line while an export of the changes only reads the disk's image (to record its hash), followed by the percentage done.

export-worker.writingChanges.note: The page's state line while an export of the changes only writes them, followed by the percentage done.

changes.baseUnreadable.message: The base image can't be read at byte {{offset}}.
changes.baseUnreadable.note: Error (message bar) of an export of changes or an import of changes when the disk's image can't be read (e.g. the file changed or went away). {{offset}} is the byte offset of the failed read.

changes.notChanges.message: This file isn't a changes file, as it names no base image. To start a machine from a disk image, use Open disk….
changes.notChanges.note: Error (message bar) of Import changes… when the file is a disk image rather than a changes file.

changes.notOurs.message: This qcow2 file wasn't made by this web app's Export › Changes only (qcow2), so its base image ({{backing}}) can't be checked. Its changes can't be imported.
changes.notOurs.note: Error (message bar) of Import changes… when the qcow2 has a backing file but not the hash this web app's exports record. {{backing}} is the backing file's name it records.

changes.otherSize.message: These changes are for a disk of {{size}} bytes, made over {{backing}}, but {{label}} has {{baseSize}} bytes. Import them into the disk they were made over.
changes.otherSize.note: Error (message bar) of Import changes… when the changes file is for a disk of another size. {{size}} is the size it records (bytes), {{backing}} its backing file's name, {{label}} the disk's name, {{baseSize}} the disk's size (bytes).

changes.checkingBase.note: The page's state line while Import changes… hashes the disk's image to check it is the one the changes were made over, followed by the percentage done.

changes.otherBase.message: These changes were made over {{backing}} (hash {{hash}}…), which isn't {{label}} (hash {{baseHash}}…). Import them into the disk they were made over.
changes.otherBase.note: Error (message bar) of Import changes… when the disk's image isn't the one the changes were made over. {{backing}} is the backing file's name the changes record, {{hash}} the first 12 hex digits of its hash, {{label}} the disk's name, {{baseHash}} the first 12 hex digits of the disk's.

changes.blockWriteFailed.message: Block {{block}} can't be written to this browser's storage.
changes.blockWriteFailed.note: Error (message bar) of Import changes… when a block can't be written to the new overlay; why (the storage is full, with its numbers: disks:overlay.storageFull.numbers) is the cause under it. {{block}} is the 4 KiB block's number.

changes.loadingChanges.note: The page's state line while Import changes… writes the changes into the overlay, followed by the percentage done.

qcow2.version.message: This qcow2 file has version {{version}}, which isn't supported. Only versions 2 and 3 are.
qcow2.version.note: Error when a qcow2 disk image (or changes file) the user opened has a version this page can't read (only 2 and 3). Shown as a detail of the error that the disks couldn't be opened, or of an import. {{version}} is the file's version number.

qcow2.backing.message: This qcow2 file is a changes file over another image, not a disk to start from. Import it with Import changes… into the disk it was made over.
qcow2.backing.note: Error when the qcow2 the user opened as a disk has a backing file (it is a changes file). Shown as a detail of the error that the disks couldn't be opened.

qcow2.encrypted.message: This qcow2 file is encrypted, which isn't supported.
qcow2.encrypted.note: Error when the qcow2 disk image (or changes file) the user opened is encrypted. Shown as a detail of the error that the disks couldn't be opened, or of an import.

qcow2.externalData.message: This qcow2 file keeps its data in an external file, which isn't supported.
qcow2.externalData.note: Error when the qcow2 disk image the user opened keeps its data in another file. Shown as a detail of the error that the disks couldn't be opened.

qcow2.extendedL2.message: This qcow2 file uses extended L2 entries, which aren't supported.
qcow2.extendedL2.note: Error when the qcow2 disk image the user opened uses extended L2 entries (subclusters). Shown as a detail of the error that the disks couldn't be opened.

qcow2.unknownFeatures.message: This qcow2 file uses unknown incompatible features (0x{{features}}).
qcow2.unknownFeatures.note: Error when the qcow2 disk image the user opened has incompatible features this page doesn't know. Shown as a detail of the error that the disks couldn't be opened. {{features}} is their bits in hex.

qcow2.zstd.message: This qcow2 file is compressed with zstd, which isn't supported.
qcow2.zstd.note: Error when the qcow2 disk image the user opened is compressed with zstd. Shown as a detail of the error that the disks couldn't be opened.

qcow2.changesClusterBits.message: This changes file's cluster size isn't supported (cluster_bits {{bits}}). Clusters must be from 4 KiB to 2 MiB.
qcow2.changesClusterBits.note: Error (message bar) of Import changes… when the changes file's clusters are smaller than 4 KiB or larger than 2 MiB (cluster_bits outside 12–21). {{bits}} is its cluster_bits field.

qcow2.unsupportedFeatures.message: This changes file uses incompatible features that aren't supported (0x{{features}}).
qcow2.unsupportedFeatures.note: Error (message bar) of Import changes… when the changes file has incompatible features this page doesn't read. {{features}} is their bits in hex.

qcow2.zstdClusters.message: This changes file has clusters compressed with zstd, which isn't supported.
qcow2.zstdClusters.note: Error (message bar) of Import changes… when the changes file's clusters are compressed with zstd.

qcow2-write.backingNameTooLong.message: The base image's file name is too long to record in the changes file.
qcow2-write.backingNameTooLong.note: Error (message bar) of Export › Changes only when the image's file name is too long to record as the changes file's backing file.

qcow2-write.overlayUnreadable.message: Block {{block}} of the overlay can't be read from this browser's storage.
qcow2-write.overlayUnreadable.note: Error (message bar) of Export › Changes only when a block of the disk's overlay can't be read from the browser's storage. {{block}} is the block's number.

qcow2-write.diskUnreadable.message: The disk can't be read at byte {{offset}}.
qcow2-write.diskUnreadable.note: Error (message bar) of a disk's export (whole, raw or qcow2) when the disk can't be read (e.g. its file changed or went away). {{offset}} is the byte offset of the failed read.

stored.imageUnreadable.message: The image can't be read at byte {{offset}}.
stored.imageUnreadable.note: Error under the fields of Add a disk › A file, copied into this browser when the file can't be read while it is copied. {{offset}} is the byte offset of the failed read.

stored.writeFailed.message: The disk can't be written to this browser's storage.
stored.writeFailed.note: Error when a stored disk's blocks can't be written: under the fields of Add a disk › A file, copied into this browser, or on the Machines page when Merge into the disk fails; why (the storage is full, with its numbers: disks:overlay.storageFull.numbers) is the line under it.

stored.stateWriteFailed.message: The disk's state can't be written to this browser's storage.
stored.stateWriteFailed.note: Error on the Machines page (or when a machine opens a stored disk) when a stored disk's state file can't be written while an overlay is merged into it.

chunked.notManifest.message: This JSON file isn't a chunked image's manifest (its format is {{format}}).
chunked.notManifest.note: Error when a disk's URL ends in .json but isn't a chunked image's manifest: in Add a disk › From a URL's check, or as a detail when the disks can't be opened. {{format}} is the format the JSON names ("undefined" if none).

chunked.malformed.message: The chunked image's manifest is malformed.
chunked.malformed.note: Error when a chunked image's manifest is missing fields or they don't agree: in Add a disk › From a URL's check, or as a detail when the disks can't be opened.

overlay.storageFull.message: This browser's storage is full. Free up space on the Machines page, whose bottom bar shows what takes this browser's storage.
overlay.storageFull.note: Error details: a write into the browser's storage (a kept snapshot, a suspended machine, a snapshot's disk changes restored, a disk or snapshot file imported, Import changes…) was refused, and the browser doesn't say how much it holds. The cause under the error's headline (Couldn't save the snapshot, Couldn't suspend the machine, Couldn't import …, The disk can't be written to this browser's storage.).

overlay.storageFull.numbers.message: This browser's storage is full ({{used, bytes}} used of {{quota, bytes}}). Free up space on the Machines page, whose bottom bar shows what takes this browser's storage.
overlay.storageFull.numbers.note: Error details: a write into the browser's storage (a kept snapshot, a suspended machine, a snapshot's disk changes restored, a disk or snapshot file imported, Import changes…) was refused. The cause under the error's headline (Couldn't save the snapshot, Couldn't suspend the machine, Couldn't import …, The disk can't be written to this browser's storage.). {{used}} is what this web app's storage holds, {{quota}} what the browser says it gives it (in a private window the browser refuses writes well before it).

main.needsUser_one.message: Allow access to {{names}}, or select the file again, to start the machine. This browser lets a web app read a file on your computer only once you allow it in the current session.
main.needsUser_one.note: What the message bar (under the toolbar) says before a start when a disk of the machine is a file this browser lets this web app read only after a click (Allow and start, or Select and start, follows); {{names}} is the disk's name.

main.needsUser_other.message: Allow access to {{names}}, or select the files again, to start the machine. This browser lets a web app read a file on your computer only once you allow it in the current session.
main.needsUser_other.note: What the message bar (under the toolbar) says before a start when several disks of the machine are files this browser lets this web app read only after a click; {{names}} is their names, {{count}} how many.

main.pickAgain.note: Title of the browser's file picker opened by Select and start, for a disk whose file must be given again; {{name}} is the disk's name.

main.otherFile.message: Use {{file}} anyway? It isn't the file this disk was made from ({{name}}, {{bytes}} bytes, modified {{when}}). The disk's overlays hold changes made on top of that file, which may not make sense on top of this one.
main.otherFile.note: Text of the question asked when the file selected again for a disk isn't the one it was made from: {{file}} is the file selected, {{name}}, {{bytes}} and {{when}} the disk's file's name, size and date.

main.otherFile.title.note: Title of the question asked when the file picked again for a disk isn't the one it was made from.

main.otherFile.ok.note: The confirm button (drawn as a warning) of the question asked when the file picked again for a disk isn't the one it was made from.

main.overlayName.note: The name a disk's first overlay gets (its changes, made at the machine's first start; the Machines page's Disks tab shows it and can rename it).

main.allowAndStart.note: Button in the message bar (under the toolbar) when the machine's disk files need the user's permission: it asks the browser for it, then starts.

main.pickAndStart.note: Button in the message bar (under the toolbar) when a disk's file must be selected again: it opens the browser's file picker, then starts.

main.notOpened.note: Error headline in the message bar (under the toolbar) when a start couldn't prepare the machine's disks (Retry follows); why is the detail under it.

main.disks.note: Button in the message bar (under the toolbar) that opens the machine's Disks tab on the Machines page: when the machine has no disks yet, or when its disk's changes were made over another image.

main.resetDisk.note: Button in the message bar (under the toolbar) for a test machine whose disk's changes were made over another image (or whose reset failed): it asks, then deletes the changes.

main.noDisks.message: {{name}} has no disks yet. Add one on its Disks tab.
main.noDisks.note: What the message bar (under the toolbar) says when the machine kept in this browser has no disks (Disks… follows); {{name}} is the machine's name.

main.theDisk.note: Names a disk the user opened, inside a question or a notice (Reset the disk, a snapshot's load); {{name}} is its file's name.

main.machineDisk.note: Names a test machine's own disk (its image), inside a question (Reset the disk, Import changes, a snapshot's load); {{machine}} is the machine's name.

main.reset.confirm.message: Reset {{disk}}? This will delete everything the machine wrote to it, including your files, installed packages and settings. The machine will then boot from the unchanged base image.
main.reset.confirm.note: Text of the question asked by Reset disk… when the machine has written nothing to it yet; {{disk}} names the disk.

main.reset.confirm.size.message: Reset {{disk}}? This will delete everything the machine wrote to it ({{size, bytes}}), including your files, installed packages and settings. The machine will then boot from the unchanged base image.
main.reset.confirm.size.note: Text of the question asked by Reset disk…; {{disk}} names the disk, {{size}} what the machine has written to it.

main.reset.title.note: Title of the question asked by Reset disk….

main.reset.ok.note: The confirm button (drawn as a warning) of the question asked by Reset disk….

main.resetting.note: The machine's state in the status bar while Reset disk… deletes the disk's changes.

main.reset.failed.note: Error headline in the message bar (under the toolbar) when Reset disk… failed (Reset disk… and Retry follow); under it disks:main.inUse, the advice, then why.

main.inUse.message: Close other tabs of this web app, as one of them may have the disk open, then try again.
main.inUse.note: Error details: the cause under the headline disks:main.reset.failed, on the line under it in the same place; what happened.

main.openFailed.note: Error headline in the message bar (under the toolbar) when the file picked with Open disk… couldn't be opened; why is the detail under it.

main.changes.noDisk.message: {{name}} holds changes to a disk. Open that disk first with Open disk…, then import the changes.
main.changes.noDisk.note: Notice when a changes file (a disk's export of its changes) is opened or dropped on a page with no disk open; {{name}} is the file's name.

main.boot.confirm.message: Boot from {{name}}? This will forcibly power off the machine and boot it again from this disk, so unsaved work in the guest will be lost. The changes made to the current disk are kept.
main.boot.confirm.note: Text of the question asked when another disk is opened on a test machine while it runs; {{name}} is the disk's file name or URL.

main.boot.ok.note: The confirm button (drawn as a warning) of the question asked when another disk is opened while the machine runs.

main.changes.runsElsewhere.message: {{name}} is running in another tab. Power it off there first.
main.changes.runsElsewhere.note: Notice when changes are imported into a disk of a machine that runs in another tab; {{name}} is the machine's name.

main.changes.notChanges.message: {{name}} isn't a changes file. Changes files are qcow2 files made by Export › Changes only (qcow2). To start a machine from a disk image, use Open disk….
main.changes.notChanges.note: Notice when a file imported as changes isn't a changes file; {{name}} is the file's name.

main.changes.noHash.message: {{name}} wasn't made by this web app's Export › Changes only (qcow2), so its base image ({{backing}}) can't be checked and its changes can't be imported.
main.changes.noHash.note: Notice when a qcow2 imported as changes wasn't made by this web app; {{name}} is the file's name, {{backing}} the backing file it names.

main.changes.intoOverlay.message: They will go into a new overlay of {{disk}}, and the machine will switch to it. The current overlay is kept.
main.changes.intoOverlay.note: What happens, in the question asked before changes are imported into a disk of a machine kept in this browser; {{disk}} is the disk's name.

main.changes.replace.message: They will replace everything the machine has written to {{disk}}, and the firmware's settings.
main.changes.replace.note: What happens, in the question asked before changes are loaded onto a test machine's disk that has nothing written yet; {{disk}} names the disk.

main.changes.replace.size.message: They will replace everything the machine has written to {{disk}} ({{size, bytes}}), and the firmware's settings.
main.changes.replace.size.note: What happens, in the question asked before changes are loaded onto a test machine's disk; {{disk}} names the disk, {{size}} what the machine has written to it.

main.changes.confirm.note: Text of the question asked before changes are imported (Import changes…, or a changes file dropped on the page) while the machine is off: {{name}} is the file's name, {{into}} where they go.

main.changes.confirm.running.message: Import the changes in {{name}}? {{into}} This will forcibly power off the machine, which will be started again afterwards.
main.changes.confirm.running.note: Text of the question asked before changes are imported while the machine runs: {{name}} is the file's name, {{into}} where they go.

main.changes.title.note: Title of the question asked before changes are imported into a disk.

main.changes.ok.note: The confirm button of the question asked before changes are imported into a disk.

main.changes.loaded.message: Imported the changes in {{name}} into a new overlay of {{disk}}.
main.changes.loaded.note: Notice in the message bar (under the toolbar) once changes were imported into a disk; {{name}} is the file's name, {{disk}} the disk's.

main.changes.failed.note: Error headline in the message bar (under the toolbar) when an import of changes failed; under it, disks:main.changes.failed.unchanged (or disks:main.inUse when another tab has the disk open, and Retry follows), then why.

main.changes.failed.unchanged.note: Error details: the line under the headline disks:main.changes.failed, before why the import failed; the disk is as it was.

main.changes.loading.note: The machine's state in the status bar while changes are imported into its disk (a percentage follows).

main.save.type.changes.note: The kind of file in the browser's save dialog of a disk's Export, Changes only.

main.save.type.qcow2.note: The kind of file in the browser's save dialog of a disk's Export, the whole disk as qcow2.

main.save.type.raw.note: The kind of file in the browser's save dialog of a disk's Export, the whole disk as a raw image.

main.save.runsElsewhere.message: {{name}} is running from this disk in another tab. Power it off there first.
main.save.runsElsewhere.note: Notice when a disk is exported while a machine in another tab runs from it; {{name}} is the machine's name.

main.save.emptied.message: The save dialog emptied {{name}}, the file this machine's disk reads from, so nothing was saved. The machine can't read its disk any more. Next time, save to a different file.
main.save.emptied.note: Error in the message bar (under the toolbar) when the file picked in a disk's Export save dialog was the disk's own file (the dialog emptied it); {{name}} is the file's name.

main.save.nothing.message: The machine hasn't written anything to the disk yet.
main.save.nothing.note: Detail under Couldn't save the disk in the message bar (under the toolbar) when the disk's changes are exported before the machine wrote any.

main.saved.note: Notice in the message bar (under the toolbar) once a disk was exported whole; {{name}} is the file's name, {{size}} its size.

main.saved.changes.message: Saved {{name}} ({{size, bytes}}, {{blocks}} changed blocks). Keep {{base}} too, as this file is useless without it.
main.saved.changes.note: Notice in the message bar (under the toolbar) once a disk's changes were exported; {{name}} is the file's name, {{size}} its size, {{blocks}} how many blocks changed, {{base}} the image they go over.

main.save.failed.note: Error headline in the message bar (under the toolbar) when a disk's export failed; why is the detail under it; disks:main.inUse comes first when another tab has the disk open (Retry follows).

main.save.confirm.message: Power off the machine to save its disk? This will forcibly power off the machine, so unsaved work in the guest will be lost. For a clean disk, shut the guest down first. The machine will be started again afterwards.
main.save.confirm.note: Text of the question asked when the disk of the running machine is exported.

main.save.title.note: Title of the question asked when the disk of the running machine is exported.

main.save.ok.note: The confirm button (drawn as a warning) of the question asked when the disk of the running machine is exported.

main.saving.note: The machine's state in the status bar when a disk's export starts (its phases and percentages follow).

devices.ramdiskFull.message: The ramdisk is out of memory, as this browser tab can't get any more. The guest's writes to it fail with I/O errors. Delete files on it and trim it (fstrim) to make room.
devices.ramdiskFull.note: Error in the message bar (under the toolbar) while the machine runs, when a ramdisk can't grow (the tab has no more memory).

devices.storageFull.message: This browser's storage is full. The guest's writes to the disk fail with I/O errors, and its filesystem may become read-only until the machine is restarted. Free up space on the Machines page, whose bottom bar shows what takes this browser's storage, then restart the machine if it needs it.
devices.storageFull.note: Error in the message bar (under the toolbar) while the machine runs, when a disk's write found the browser's storage full (said at most once a minute).

devices.storageFull.numbers.message: This browser's storage is full ({{used, bytes}} used of {{quota, bytes}}). The guest's writes to the disk fail with I/O errors, and its filesystem may become read-only until the machine is restarted. Free up space on the Machines page, whose bottom bar shows what takes this browser's storage, then restart the machine if it needs it.
devices.storageFull.numbers.note: Error in the message bar (under the toolbar) while the machine runs, when a disk's write found the browser's storage full (said at most once a minute); {{used}} is what this web app's storage holds, {{quota}} what the browser gives it.

ExportMenu.title.message: Save the disk, or just the changes made to it, to a file
ExportMenu.title.note: Export menu (on a machine's Disks tab, and on each overlay in a disk's Overlays dialog): the tooltip of a disk's Export menu button.

ExportMenu.label.note: Export menu (on a machine's Disks tab, and on each overlay in a disk's Overlays dialog): the label of a disk's menu button that saves it to a file (its choices: changes only, whole disk as qcow2 or raw).

ExportMenu.changes.title.message: A qcow2 containing just the changes over the base image. Keep the latter, otherwise this file is useless.
ExportMenu.changes.title.note: Export menu (on a machine's Disks tab, and on each overlay in a disk's Overlays dialog): the tooltip of Changes only (qcow2).

ExportMenu.changes.note: Export menu (on a machine's Disks tab, and on each overlay in a disk's Overlays dialog): the item that saves what the machine wrote over the disk's image, as a qcow2 backed by the image (not for a blank disk).

ExportMenu.qcow2.title.message: Save the whole disk as a qcow2 file, leaving out blocks that are all zeros.
ExportMenu.qcow2.title.note: Export menu (on a machine's Disks tab, and on each overlay in a disk's Overlays dialog): the tooltip of Whole disk (qcow2).

ExportMenu.qcow2.note: Export menu (on a machine's Disks tab, and on each overlay in a disk's Overlays dialog): the item that saves the whole disk, with its changes, as a qcow2.

ExportMenu.raw.title.message: Save the whole disk as a raw image.
ExportMenu.raw.title.note: Export menu (on a machine's Disks tab, and on each overlay in a disk's Overlays dialog): the tooltip of Whole disk (raw).

ExportMenu.raw.note: Export menu (on a machine's Disks tab, and on each overlay in a disk's Overlays dialog): the item that saves the whole disk, with its changes, as a raw image.

ExportMenu.compress.title.message: Compress the qcow2 file with deflate, as qemu-img convert -c does. The file is about half the size and takes longer to write.
ExportMenu.compress.title.note: Export menu (on a machine's Disks tab, and on each overlay in a disk's Overlays dialog): the tooltip of the Compress the qcow2 checkbox.

ExportMenu.compress.note: Export menu (on a machine's Disks tab, and on each overlay in a disk's Overlays dialog): the checkbox (remembered) that compresses a qcow2 export's clusters.

ExportMenu.hint.message: Exporting will forcibly power off a machine using the disk. After the file is written, the machine will be started again.
ExportMenu.hint.note: Export menu (on a machine's Disks tab, and on each overlay in a disk's Overlays dialog): the small note at the menu's bottom.

Overlays.title.note: Overlays dialog (a disk's Overlays…, on the Machines page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab): the dialog's title. {{disk}} is the disk's name.

Overlays.note.message: Each overlay holds changes made on top of the disk's base image. A machine writes to the overlay chosen for this disk on its Disks tab.
Overlays.note.note: Overlays dialog (a disk's Overlays…, on the Machines page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab): the note under the title.

Overlays.meta.note: Overlays dialog (a disk's Overlays…, on the Machines page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab): the small line under an overlay's name, before who uses it. {{size}} is what it holds, {{when}} when it was made (date and time).

Overlays.meta.forked.message: {{size}} of changes, created {{when}} when a snapshot was restored
Overlays.meta.forked.note: Overlays dialog (a disk's Overlays…, on the Machines page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab): the small line under the name of an overlay that a snapshot's restore forked off another, before who uses it. {{size}} is what it holds, {{when}} when it was made (date and time).

Overlays.usedBy.note: Overlays dialog (a disk's Overlays…, on the Machines page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab): after an overlay's size and date: the machines whose attachment of the disk writes to it. {{machines}} is their names, joined with commas.

Overlays.usedByNone.note: Overlays dialog (a disk's Overlays…, on the Machines page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab): after an overlay's size and date when no machine writes to it.

Overlays.none.note: Overlays dialog (a disk's Overlays…, on the Machines page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab): in place of the list when the disk has none.

Overlays.close.note: Overlays dialog (a disk's Overlays…, on the Machines page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab): the button that closes the dialog.

Overlays.rename.text.message: Enter a new name for the overlay:
Overlays.rename.text.note: Overlays dialog (a disk's Overlays…, on the Machines page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab): the question of the text prompt that an overlay's Rename opens, above the field holding its current name.

Overlays.rename.title.note: Overlays dialog (a disk's Overlays…, on the Machines page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab): the title of the prompt that an overlay's Rename opens. {{name}} is the overlay's current name.

Overlays.rename.ok.note: Overlays dialog (a disk's Overlays…, on the Machines page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab): the confirm button of the rename prompt of an overlay.

Overlays.busy.rename.note: Machines page: the busy line (shown with a trailing …) while an overlay is renamed.

Overlays.failed.rename.note: Machines page: the error headline when an overlay's Rename fails; why is the detail under it.

Overlays.delete.confirm.message: Delete the overlay {{name}}? This will delete the {{size}} of changes made on top of the base image.
Overlays.delete.confirm.note: Overlays dialog (a disk's Overlays…, on the Machines page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab): the confirmation (OK/Cancel, the OK in red) that an overlay's Delete asks. {{name}} is the overlay's name, {{size}} what it holds (e.g. "12.0 MiB").

Overlays.delete.ok.note: Overlays dialog (a disk's Overlays…, on the Machines page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab): the confirm button of the question before an overlay is deleted.

Overlays.busy.delete.note: Machines page: the busy line (shown with a trailing …) while an overlay is deleted.

Overlays.failed.delete.note: Machines page: the error headline when an overlay's Delete fails; why is the detail under it.

Overlays.merge.other.note: Overlays dialog (a disk's Overlays…, on the Machines page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab): one overlay in the list of those a merge deletes (Overlays.merge.others). {{name}} is the overlay's name, {{size}} what it holds.

Overlays.merge.others.message: This will delete the other overlays associated with this disk: {{list}}.
Overlays.merge.others.note: Overlays dialog (a disk's Overlays…, on the Machines page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab): the line of the merge's confirmation (Overlays.merge.confirm) when the disk has other overlays: a merge deletes them. Starts on a new line. {{list}} is the overlays (each Overlays.merge.other), joined with commas.

Overlays.merge.snapshots_one.message: {{count}} snapshot will no longer be restorable as it references this disk or one of its overlays.
Overlays.merge.snapshots_one.note: Overlays dialog (a disk's Overlays…, on the Machines page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab): the line of the merge's confirmation (Overlays.merge.confirm) when one snapshot pins the disk or the overlays involved. Starts on a new line. {{count}} is 1.

Overlays.merge.snapshots_other.message: {{count}} snapshots will no longer be restorable as they reference this disk or one of its overlays.
Overlays.merge.snapshots_other.note: Overlays dialog (a disk's Overlays…, on the Machines page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab): the line of the merge's confirmation (Overlays.merge.confirm) when several snapshots pin the disk or the overlays involved. Starts on a new line. {{count}} is how many.

Overlays.merge.confirm.message: Merge {{overlay}} into {{disk}}? The changes in it will become part of the disk.{{others}}{{snapshots}}
Overlays.merge.confirm.note: Overlays dialog (a disk's Overlays…, on the Machines page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab): the confirmation that Merge into the disk asks (OK in red when it deletes other overlays). {{overlay}} is the overlay's name, {{disk}} the stored disk's; {{others}} is Overlays.merge.others or nothing, {{snapshots}} Overlays.merge.snapshots or nothing.

Overlays.merge.ok.note: Overlays dialog (a disk's Overlays…, on the Machines page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab): the confirm button of the question before an overlay is merged into its stored disk.

Overlays.busy.merge.note: Machines page: the busy line (shown with a trailing …) while an overlay's changes are written into its disk's base image, stored in this browser.

Overlays.failed.merge.note: Machines page: the error headline when Merge into the disk fails; why is the detail under it.

Overlays.renameButton.title.note: Overlays dialog (a disk's Overlays…, on the Machines page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab): the tooltip of Rename, on each overlay.

Overlays.renameButton.note: Overlays dialog (a disk's Overlays…, on the Machines page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab): the button on each overlay that renames it (a prompt asks the name).

Overlays.deleteButton.title.message: Delete this overlay. This loses all changes from the base image that are contained within.
Overlays.deleteButton.title.note: Overlays dialog (a disk's Overlays…, on the Machines page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab): the tooltip of Delete, on each overlay.

Overlays.deleteButton.note: Overlays dialog (a disk's Overlays…, on the Machines page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab): the button on each overlay that deletes it (after a confirmation).

Overlays.mergeButton.title.message: Write this overlay's changes into the disk's base image, stored in this browser. Merging deletes the disk's other overlays.
Overlays.mergeButton.title.note: Overlays dialog (a disk's Overlays…, on the Machines page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab): the tooltip of Merge into the disk.

Overlays.mergeButton.note: Overlays dialog (a disk's Overlays…, on the Machines page's Disks pane or a machine's Disks tab): the button on each overlay of a stored disk that writes its changes into the disk (after a confirmation).

AttachDisk.title.note: Attach to a machine dialog (the Machines page's Disks pane, a disk's Attach to a machine…): the dialog's title. {{disk}} is the disk's name.

AttachDisk.note.message: The disk will be attached after the machine's other disks, with its overlays. If the machine is running in this tab, you will be asked to power it off first.
AttachDisk.note.note: Attach to a machine dialog (the Machines page's Disks pane, a disk's Attach to a machine…): the note under the title.

AttachDisk.meta.note: Attach to a machine dialog (the Machines page's Disks pane, a disk's Attach to a machine…): the small line under a machine's name. {{n}} is how many disks it has, {{max}} the most a machine can have (16).

AttachDisk.running.note: Attach to a machine dialog (the Machines page's Disks pane, a disk's Attach to a machine…): after a machine's disks in its line when it runs (in this tab or another).

AttachDisk.has.message: The disk is already attached to this machine.
AttachDisk.has.note: Attach to a machine dialog (the Machines page's Disks pane, a disk's Attach to a machine…): the line under a machine that has the disk already, whose Attach is off.

AttachDisk.full.message: This machine already has {{max}} disks, the most a machine can have. Detach one of them to attach this disk.
AttachDisk.full.note: Attach to a machine dialog (the Machines page's Disks pane, a disk's Attach to a machine…): the line under a machine that has as many disks as it can, whose Attach is off. {{max}} is that number (16).

AttachDisk.otherTab.message: This machine is running in another tab. Power it off there to attach this disk.
AttachDisk.otherTab.note: Attach to a machine dialog (the Machines page's Disks pane, a disk's Attach to a machine…): the line under a machine that runs in another tab, whose Attach is off.

AttachDisk.attach.note: Attach to a machine dialog (the Machines page's Disks pane, a disk's Attach to a machine…): the button on a machine that attaches the disk to it, last (asking first to power off the machine running in this tab).

AttachDisk.none.message: No machines are stored in this browser.
AttachDisk.none.note: Attach to a machine dialog (the Machines page's Disks pane, a disk's Attach to a machine…): in place of the list when there are no machines.

AttachDisk.cancel.note: Attach to a machine dialog (the Machines page's Disks pane, a disk's Attach to a machine…): the button that closes the dialog without attaching.

AttachDisk.busy.note: Machines page: the busy line (shown with a trailing …) while the Attach to a machine dialog attaches a disk.

DisksPane.overlaysButton.title.message: Show all of this disk's overlays, to rename, delete or export them.
DisksPane.overlaysButton.title.note: Machines page, Disks pane (Disks under the list of machines): the tooltip of Overlays… on a disk.

DisksPane.overlaysButton.note: Machines page, Disks pane (Disks under the list of machines): the button on a disk with overlays that opens its Overlays dialog.

DisksPane.attach.title.message: Choose a machine to attach this disk to, with its overlays.
DisksPane.attach.title.note: Machines page, Disks pane (Disks under the list of machines): the tooltip of Attach to a machine… on a disk.

DisksPane.attach.note: Machines page, Disks pane (Disks under the list of machines): the button on a disk that opens the Attach to a machine dialog (the list of machines).

DisksPane.deleteButton.title.message: Delete the disk and its overlays, freeing the space they take in this browser.
DisksPane.deleteButton.title.note: Machines page, Disks pane (Disks under the list of machines): the tooltip of Delete on a disk no machine has.

DisksPane.deleteAttached.title.message: A disk attached to a machine can't be deleted. Detach it from {{machines}} first.
DisksPane.deleteAttached.title.note: Machines page, Disks pane (Disks under the list of machines): the tooltip of Delete, turned off, on a disk some machines have. {{machines}} is their names, joined with commas.

DisksPane.deleteButton.note: Machines page, Disks pane (Disks under the list of machines): the button on a disk that deletes it with its overlays (after a confirmation); off while a machine has the disk.

DisksPane.none.message: No disks are stored in this browser.
DisksPane.none.note: Machines page, Disks pane (Disks under the list of machines): in place of the list when there are no disks.

DisksPane.busy.deleting.note: Machines page: the busy line (shown with a trailing …) while a disk and its overlays are deleted.

DisksPane.delete.stored.message: the disk ({{size}}) stored in this browser
DisksPane.delete.stored.note: Machines page, Disks pane: what deleting a stored disk deletes, in the confirmation (DisksPane.delete.confirm). {{size}} is the disk's size.

DisksPane.delete.remote.message: what this browser keeps of the disk
DisksPane.delete.remote.note: Machines page, Disks pane: what deleting a file's or a URL's disk deletes, in the confirmation (DisksPane.delete.confirm).

DisksPane.delete.disk.note: Machines page, Disks pane: what deleting a blank disk or a ramdisk deletes, in the confirmation (DisksPane.delete.confirm).

DisksPane.delete.remains.file.message: The file itself remains on your computer.
DisksPane.delete.remains.file.note: Machines page, Disks pane: the last line of a file's disk's delete confirmation (DisksPane.delete.confirm), on a new line: deleting it leaves the file itself alone.

DisksPane.delete.remains.url.message: The image itself remains on its web server.
DisksPane.delete.remains.url.note: Machines page, Disks pane: the last line of a URL's disk's delete confirmation (DisksPane.delete.confirm), on a new line: deleting it leaves the image on the server alone.

DisksPane.delete.confirm_zero.note: Machines page, Disks pane: the confirmation (OK in red) that a disk's Delete asks when it has no overlay (a ramdisk, or a disk no machine has used). {{name}} is the disk's name, {{what}} DisksPane.delete.stored, .remote or .disk, {{remains}} DisksPane.delete.remains.* or nothing.

DisksPane.delete.confirm_one.message: Delete {{name}}? This will delete {{what}} and its {{count}} overlay.{{remains}}
DisksPane.delete.confirm_one.note: Machines page, Disks pane: the confirmation (OK in red) that a disk's Delete asks, its overlay empty. {{name}} is the disk's name, {{what}} DisksPane.delete.stored, .remote or .disk, {{count}} 1, {{remains}} DisksPane.delete.remains.file or .url (on a new line) for a file's or a URL's disk, else nothing.

DisksPane.delete.confirm_other.message: Delete {{name}}? This will delete {{what}} and its {{count}} overlays.{{remains}}
DisksPane.delete.confirm_other.note: Machines page, Disks pane: the confirmation (OK in red) that a disk's Delete asks, its overlays (none or several) empty. {{name}} is the disk's name, {{what}} DisksPane.delete.stored, .remote or .disk, {{count}} how many overlays, {{remains}} DisksPane.delete.remains.file or .url (on a new line) for a file's or a URL's disk, else nothing.

DisksPane.delete.confirmSized_one.message: Delete {{name}}? This will delete {{what}} and its {{count}} overlay, with the {{size}} of changes made on top of the base image.{{remains}}
DisksPane.delete.confirmSized_one.note: Machines page, Disks pane: the confirmation (OK in red) that a disk's Delete asks when its overlay holds something. {{name}} is the disk's name, {{what}} DisksPane.delete.stored, .remote or .disk, {{count}} 1, {{size}} what the overlay holds, {{remains}} DisksPane.delete.remains.file or .url (on a new line) for a file's or a URL's disk, else nothing.

DisksPane.delete.confirmSized_other.message: Delete {{name}}? This will delete {{what}} and its {{count}} overlays, with the {{size}} of changes made on top of the base image.{{remains}}
DisksPane.delete.confirmSized_other.note: Machines page, Disks pane: the confirmation (OK in red) that a disk's Delete asks when its overlays hold something. {{name}} is the disk's name, {{what}} DisksPane.delete.stored, .remote or .disk, {{count}} how many overlays, {{size}} what they hold together, {{remains}} DisksPane.delete.remains.file or .url (on a new line) for a file's or a URL's disk, else nothing.

DisksPane.delete.title.note: Machines page, Disks pane: the title of the confirmation a disk's Delete asks.

DisksPane.delete.ok.note: Machines page, Disks pane: the confirm button of the question before a disk is deleted.
